summary: @zmtcdn/ui postinstall beacons installer host metadata to hinny.shop
details: The postinstall.js lifecycle script runs automatically on `npm install` and collects installer-identifying data — `os.hostname()`, `os.platform()`, `os.userInfo().username`, `process.cwd()`, the list of `process.env` key names, and a timestamp — then POSTs the JSON blob via `https.request` to the hardcoded endpoint https://www.hinny.shop/api. The package name uses a vendor-style scope (`@zmtcdn/ui`) and an implausibly high version (9999.0.7) consistent with a dependency-confusion lure, and the fetch destination is unrelated to any declared publisher. No user opt-in, no documentation of the beacon, and no legitimate functional purpose for sending this data off-host at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
